phases.name: Machine-token auth — migration, MachineToken primitive, verifier, CSRF-exempt extractor

steps.name: Add 0007_machine_tokens migration, Store jti-registry/denylist repo, and extend startup probe
criteria: Driven port: a jti-keyed machine_tokens registry/denylist in Postgres; NO secret/hash column (the JWT is the secret) — columns jti (PK), user_id, workspace_id, scope_team_id, expires_at, revoked_at, last_used_at, label.

New forward-only, advisory-locked migration crates/foundry-store/migrations/0007_machine_tokens.sql (style matching 0001-0006); Store repo methods insert / find_by_jti / revoke / list / touch_last_used added to crates/foundry-store/src/lib.rs following the existing repo pattern.

Store::probe (crates/foundry-store/src/lib.rs, ~:139) extended to assert the machine_tokens table + its jti/revoked_at/scope_team_id/workspace_id/user_id/expires_at columns exist (mirrors the 0006 column check); a pre-0007 schema yields health.startup.refused {reason:'store_probe_failed'} and non-zero exit (Earned Trust, Principle 12).
Files: crates/foundry-store/migrations/0007_machine_tokens.sql, crates/foundry-store/src/lib.rs.

Rust tests: standard #[test] example-based repo tests against the real Postgres harness (@real-io) — insert then find_by_jti round-trip, revoke flips revoked_at, find_by_jti after revoke still returns the row (denylist semantics), probe fails on a pre-0007 schema. No proptest (CRUD, not invariant-shaped).

steps.name: Add foundry-auth MachineToken EdDSA mint/verify (jsonwebtoken dep) + AppState verifier across harness sites
criteria: Driven port: foundry_auth::MachineToken EdDSA mint/verify primitive — sign(claims, signing_key) and verify(jwt, public_keys) with the jsonwebtoken Validation pinned to algorithms = [EdDSA] (rejects every other alg and alg:none); claims carry sub=user_id, jti, scope, exp, iat.

Adds the ONE net-new runtime dependency jsonwebtoken = "9" (MIT, in the allowed cargo-deny set) to the workspace Cargo.toml + crates/foundry-auth/Cargo.toml; primitive is additive to the existing argon2/HMAC/BootstrapToken module.

AppState gains required field machine_token_verifier: Arc<MachineTokenVerifier>, built at boot from MACHINE_TOKEN_PUBLIC_KEYS exactly as session_secret is built from SESSION_SECRET (overlapping-key rotation supported); a NEW key-material startup probe signs+verifies a throwaway claim set and refuses startup with health.startup.refused {reason:'machine_token_key'} on a malformed/mismatched key (Earned Trust).

The ~4 acceptance AppState construction sites (crates/foundry-acceptance/src/support/harness.rs ~:267, multi_replica_harness.rs ~:236 and ~:387, steps/us_03_backup_restore.rs ~:980) + main.rs set a FIXED test Ed25519 keypair (mirrors the fixed test session_secret) so W05b/W05c can mint+verify real tokens.

Files: Cargo.toml (workspace), crates/foundry-auth/src/lib.rs, crates/foundry-auth/Cargo.toml, crates/foundry-app/src/lib.rs (AppState + boot wiring), crates/foundry-app/src/main.rs, crates/foundry-acceptance/src/support/harness.rs, crates/foundry-acceptance/src/support/multi_replica_harness.rs, crates/foundry-acceptance/src/steps/us_03_backup_restore.rs.

Rust tests: proptest IS warranted here — a sign->verify round-trip property (any well-formed claim set verifies under the matching public key) and a negative property (a token signed by a non-matching key never verifies); plus example #[test]s for exp-expired -> reject and non-EdDSA alg -> reject. The browser-regression cucumber scenario must stay GREEN (NFR-WEB-API-SEC-01).
Depends on: nothing in 02 strictly, but pairs with 02-01; the harness keypair change is what unblocks 02-03. Atomic: the credential primitive + key config + AppState field (the harness blast radius).
steps.scenario_name: The browser sign-in path is unchanged by the machine credential surface

steps.name: Implement foundry-api token_auth extractor (verify + denylist + scope) and require it on /api/v1
criteria: Driving port: every /api/v1 request now requires Authorization: Bearer <JWT>; a valid credential is authenticated as Principal::Machine and reads what its bound principal may read; the mount remains CSRF-exempt and session-exempt (outside the CSRF + tower-sessions layers).

Implements foundry_api::token_auth::verify_bearer per auth.md: parse Bearer, verify EdDSA (alg pinned via the AppState verifier), validate exp, check the jti denylist (Store::find_by_jti -> revoked_at IS NULL), build Principal::Machine; ALL of missing/malformed/bad-signature/wrong-alg/expired/forged/revoked -> 401 Unauthorized (non-enumerable, no data leak); valid-but-out-of-scope team -> 403 Forbidden. Wrapped as an axum FromRequestParts extractor applied to the /api/v1 routes.

The denylist read in token_auth is the single allowed foundry-store touch for the adapter; if the cargo-deny rule (Phase 04) would forbid it, it is routed through a foundry-services auth helper instead (architecture.md / step-skeletons B). The harness credential-granting Givens are replaced to mint real JWTs via the fixed test signing key.

Files: crates/foundry-api/src/lib.rs (token_auth + extractor + 401/403 mapping), crates/foundry-acceptance/src/steps/feature_a_programmatic.rs (mint real tokens in the granting/expired/forged/wrong-alg Givens).

Rust tests: flip the us-w05b scenarios GREEN one at a time via real HTTP (@real-io) — the @slice2-entry happy read, no-session/no-CSRF success, and the refusal catalogue (no credential, malformed, forged, expired, revoked, disallowed-algorithm, out-of-scope). Optional proptest for the scope-narrowing check (a Backend-scoped token never authorizes a non-Backend team). Example #[test]s in foundry-api for each 401/403 branch.
Depends on: 02-01 (denylist repo) + 02-02 (verifier + AppState keypair) + 01-02 (the /api/v1 mount it now guards). Atomic: the extractor + its enforcement on the existing routes.

steps.name: Add foundry-api POST/PATCH issue + comment routes with the JSON error envelope
criteria: Driving ports: POST /api/v1/teams/{team}/projects/{project}/issues (201 + created issue + Location header), PATCH .../issues/{number} (200 + updated issue), POST .../issues/{number}/comments (201 + sanitized comment), PATCH .../issues/{number}/comments/{comment_id} (200 + updated comment) — all JSON in/out, never HTML.

Implements foundry-api routes::{create_issue, change_issue_state, create_comment, edit_comment} as axum handlers calling the foundry_services write use-cases with the request's Principal::Machine; the error envelope maps Validation->422 (title_required, same copy as the UI's "Title is required"), 403 forbidden (non-author edit), 404/410 per api-contract.md; rejection bodies are JSON with no markup (NFR-WEB-API-CON-03).

An API-created change rides the SAME outbox so it reaches SSE/realtime consumers identically to a browser-created change (NFR-WEB-API-CON-02); body_html in the comment response is the core-sanitized markup inside a JSON string field (allowed by the boundary rule, not an HTML response body).

Files: crates/foundry-api/src/lib.rs (the four write handlers + routes() registration + status mapping), crates/foundry-api/Cargo.toml (no direct foundry-store write dep — writes go through foundry-services).

Optional foundry-api contract-snapshot #[test] for the v1 issue shape (NFR-WEB-API-CON-01).

phases.name: Boundary guard — xtask check-arch AST + cargo-deny crate-graph rule + injected-violation gold test

steps.name: Implement cargo xtask check-arch, add cargo-deny dep-direction bans, and stage the injected-violation gold test
criteria: Driving port: cargo xtask check-arch passes on a clean tree (zero manual steps) and fails with a named offender when a boundary is violated — the three orthogonal layers of boundary-guard.md.

Layer 1 (AST source walk in xtask): no crates/foundry-api/src/** symbol constructs axum Html / returns Html<..> / sets text/html (api!=HTML); no is_team_member/is_workspace_admin call site in foundry-api (authz belongs in foundry-services); the token_auth Validation pins algorithms = [EdDSA] (fails if a non-EdDSA alg or disabled signature validation appears). On failure it names the handler that builds a page / reports the verifier no longer pins the single allowed algorithm.

Layer 2 (cargo-deny crate graph): deny.toml bans extended so foundry-api -> foundry-store and foundry-app -> foundry-store are forbidden edges, and foundry-services -> foundry-api / foundry-services -> foundry-app reversed edges are forbidden; on violation it names the forbidden dependency. Wired into xtask ci (run_ci) and the CI lint-format job (no DB, no new infrastructure).

Layer 3 (injected-violation gold test): the acceptance harness materializes a throwaway tree copy with a planted violation (an Html(..) return in foundry-api; a foundry-api -> foundry-store dep edge in Cargo.toml; a Validation accepting any alg) and runs check-arch against THAT copy, asserting it goes red — proving the guard bites (Principle 12c self-application), mirroring support::test_migration's per-scenario staging.

Files: xtask/src/main.rs (check-arch subcommand + run_ci wiring), deny.toml (bans), crates/foundry-acceptance/src/steps/feature_a_programmatic.rs (stage the copy-with-violation + run check-arch on the copy), .github/workflows/ci.yml (lint-format step).

Rust tests: flip the us-w06 scenarios GREEN via real subprocess (@real-io, @boundary-guard) — clean tree passes; page-in-api-tier fails and names the handler; adapter-direct-DB-dependency fails and names the forbidden dep; verifier-accepts-any-alg fails and reports the lost alg pin. Example-based only (layer-4 guard, no generated input).

Depends on: 03-02 (runs after the full api/services surface exists so the clean-tree check is meaningful); independent of the read/write runtime path otherwise. Atomic: the guard tooling + its CI wiring.
steps.scenario_name: A clean tree passes the boundary check
